Before relying on an adaptation
Identify which laws actually apply, consult current authoritative sources, resolve conflicting requirements, and obtain appropriate local review for the intended use. Record sources, effective dates, scope, changes, and the reviewer's conclusion. Review again when the activity, locations, or relevant rules change.
